title: keep-codex-fast: A backup-first Codex skill for keeping local Codex state fast and recoverable
description:
The longer you use Codex, the more clogged the workspace gets. Context bloats, agent slows down. Nuke .codex to speed things up and your agent gets instant amnesia. keep-codex-fast is a backup-first skill. Before wiping redundant files or archiving old chat logs, it generates a handover document summarizing your architectural context and active tasks, then hands that compressed memory back to the freshly cleaned agent.
